# James Oliver

> Papers by James Oliver. Each piece is listed with its one-sentence claim. Links point to the markdown source, with equations in LaTeX.

## Papers

- [The Buildable Sphere](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/geodesic-dome.md): The sphere encloses a volume with the least surface, a sphere cannot be built from flat parts and geodesic domes approach it without limit.
- [The Area-Energy Principle](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/area-energy-principle.md): To exchange the most energy a thing presents the most surface and to exchange the least it presents the least.
- [The Ideal Gas Law](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/ideal-gas-law.md): In a thin gas temperature is the motion of the molecules and pressure is that motion times their number in each unit of volume, so pressure is temperature times number.
- [Moving Mass Over Land](https://jamesoliver.xyz/papers/moving-mass-over-land.md): Moving mass over level land costs only friction with the ground and with the air, which hard wheels on hard rails and cars coupled in one line each drive toward zero.
